basis.governing_question: How can Vale Verde Water Company reduce treated water lost through network leaks, tested in a two-district pilot and rolled out to all districts?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the loss-reduction program and its leak-detection routine, grounded in where and why the network loses water.

gate.label: Go/no-go on pilot
gate.decision: Approve the program design and pilot plan to start the pilot?

phases.name: Pilot
phases.objective_one_line: Test the new leak-detection routine in two districts and measure its effect on water losses against the baseline.

gate.label: Go/no-go on rollout
gate.decision: Approve the rollout of the routine to the remaining districts?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Roll out the leak-detection routine to the remaining districts so that all districts run it.

gate.label: Rollout sign-off
gate.decision: Confirm that all districts now run the new leak-detection routine?

phases.name: Measurement
phases.objective_one_line: Track water losses against the success criteria and report whether the program delivered them.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Accept the final results against the two success criteria?

workstreams.name: Water loss baseline
workstreams.answers: How much treated water does each district lose today, and where in the network?
activities: Analyze operational data on water losses by district
Review network records and maintenance logs

workstreams.name: Current leak detection
workstreams.answers: How do crews find and fix leaks today, and where does that work break down?
activities: Interview crews and staff who find and fix leaks
Review leak reports and repair records

workstreams.name: Program and routine design
workstreams.answers: What does the loss-reduction program consist of, and how will crews run the new leak-detection routine?
activities: Compare program options on agreed criteria
Detail the chosen program and the crew routine
Test the routine design with the crews who will run it

workstreams.name: Pilot plan
workstreams.answers: How will the pilot run in two districts, and how will its effect on water losses be measured?
activities: Propose the two pilot districts for steering approval
Agree measures for pilot-district water losses
Plan crew training, data collection and pilot timing

workstreams.name: Pilot readiness
workstreams.answers: Are crews and data in the two pilot districts ready for the new routine to go live?
activities: Train crews in the two pilot districts on the routine
Confirm pre-pilot loss levels in the pilot districts
Prepare the data collection for pilot results

workstreams.name: Pilot operation
workstreams.answers: Does the new routine find and fix leaks in the two pilot districts, and does water loss fall?
activities: Run the leak-detection routine in the two pilot districts
Record water losses in the pilot districts
Collect crew feedback on how the routine works

workstreams.name: Pilot results, rollout plan
workstreams.answers: What did the pilot achieve against pre-pilot losses, and how should the remaining districts follow?
activities: Compare pilot-district losses with the pre-pilot baseline
Plan the rollout sequence for the remaining districts
Capture lessons from pilot crews for the rollout

workstreams.name: Rollout readiness
workstreams.answers: Which remaining districts start first, and are their crews and data ready for the new routine?
activities: Train crews in the first rollout districts
Confirm the district sequence for the rollout
Adjust the routine with lessons from the pilot

workstreams.name: District rollout
workstreams.answers: How is the leak-detection routine put in place and kept running in every remaining district?
activities: Start the routine district by district in sequence
Coach crews on the routine as each district goes live
Resolve obstacles raised by district crews and managers

workstreams.name: Rollout tracking
workstreams.answers: Which districts run the routine, and are water losses falling where it is in place?
activities: Track which districts run the routine and since when
Compare rolled-out district losses with the baseline

workstreams.name: Water loss tracking
workstreams.answers: How have water losses changed in the pilot districts and the rest of the network since launch?
activities: Collect operational data on water losses by district
Compare pilot-district losses with pre-pilot levels
Interview district crews on how the routine runs

workstreams.name: Results against criteria
workstreams.answers: Do water losses in the pilot districts and routine use in all districts meet the success criteria?
activities: Check routine use against the all-districts criterion
Assess water loss results against the pre-pilot baseline
Write the final results report for the steering group

deliverables.name: Pilot plan for the two pilot districts
Agreed measures of pilot-district water losses
Trained crews in the two pilot districts
Leak-detection routine running in the two pilot districts
Pilot results against pre-pilot water losses
Rollout plan for the remaining districts
Trained crews in the first rollout districts
Routine running in the first rollout districts
Interim water loss results by district
Final results report against the success criteria

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align on goals, scope and ways of working
events.decision: Confirm the scope and the steering group for the engagement?
agenda: Present the scope and the plan of work
Align on access to network data and maintenance crews
Confirm how the steering group meets and decides

events.label: Workshop 1: first findings
events.purpose: Review loss baseline and current practice
events.decision: Which parts of the network should the program design focus on first?
agenda: Present the water loss baseline by district
Review how crews find and fix leaks today
Decide where the program design focuses first

events.label: Workshop 2: program design
events.purpose: Review the program and routine design
events.decision: Confirm the program design as the basis for the pilot plan?
agenda: Present the loss-reduction program design
Discuss how the routine fits crews' daily work
Confirm the basis for the pilot plan

events.label: Go/no-go on pilot
events.decision: Approve the program design and pilot plan to start the pilot?
agenda: Present the routine design and the pilot plan
Review the agreed pilot measures
Decide whether the pilot starts

events.label: Workshop 3: pilot readiness
events.purpose: Review readiness before the pilot goes live
events.decision: Is the pilot ready to go live in the two pilot districts?
agenda: Present crew training in the pilot districts
Review starting water loss levels in those districts
Decide whether the routine goes live

events.label: Go/no-go on rollout
events.decision: Approve the rollout of the routine to the remaining districts?
agenda: Present the pilot results against pre-pilot losses
Review the rollout plan for the remaining districts
Decide whether the rollout starts

events.label: Workshop 4: rollout start
events.purpose: Review readiness before rollout goes live
events.decision: Are the first rollout districts ready to start the new routine?
agenda: Present crew training and readiness by district
Review the district sequence for the rollout
Decide whether the first districts go live

events.label: Workshop 5: rollout review
events.purpose: Review rollout progress and early results
events.decision: Confirm or adjust the rollout sequence for the remaining districts?
agenda: Present the districts now running the routine
Review the rollout tracker and early water loss results
Decide any change to the rollout sequence

events.label: Rollout sign-off
events.purpose: Confirm the routine runs in all districts
events.decision: Confirm that all districts now run the new leak-detection routine?
agenda: Present the routine running in all districts
Review the rollout tracker by district
Confirm the start of the measurement stage

events.label: Check-in: interim results
events.purpose: Review interim results against the baseline
events.decision: Confirm what the final report must show on each success criterion?
agenda: Present water loss results against the baseline
Review which districts run the routine
Confirm what the final report must show

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Present final results against the criteria
events.decision: Accept the final results against the two success criteria?
agenda: Present the final results report
Review results against both success criteria
Decide whether the criteria are met

architect_notes: Confirm merging diagnostic and design (6 + 6 weeks) into one Design phase: the brief lists five stages, plans allow four.
Departing from performance_improvement: a Pilot precedes the rollout and Measurement is its own phase after it.
